baslik: 22 Palestinians killed in Israeli airstrike on house in Khan Yunis, Gaza Strip
metin:
A total of 22 Palestinians were killed and 100 injured in an Israeli airstrike targeting a house in Khan Yunis, according to the Gaza Interior Ministry announcement on Thursday.

"The bodies of 22 martyrs have been retrieved thus far, with over 100 people rescued from under the rubble of the Abu Shamala family's house and its surroundings in Khan Yunis, following bombardment by the Israeli occupation," stated a ministry statement reviewed by Anadolu.

Eyewitnesses reported to an Anadolu correspondent that the Israeli shelling caused extensive destruction of homes and properties in the area.

Khan Yunis, located in southern Gaza, became a destination after Israel ordered northern Palestinians to evacuate on October 12, despite humanitarian concerns. This directive meant over a million additional people would move to an already overcrowded southern region housing more than one million residents.

Nearly three weeks into the Israeli airstrike campaign, at least 6,546 Palestinians and 1,400 Israelis had been killed, according to official figures.

Gaza officials and residents have criticized Israeli airstrikes hitting residential areas, hospitals, and places of worship, actions that violate international warfare regulations.

The Gaza conflict initiated on October 7 when Hamas launched Operation Al-Aqsa Flood, involving rocket barrages and infiltrations by land, sea, and air into Israel.

Hamas attributed the operation to retaliation for the Al-Aqsa Mosque storming and escalating Israeli settler violence against Palestinians.

Israel responded with extensive bombardment of Hamas targets throughout Gaza.

Gaza's 2.3 million residents face severe shortages of food, water, medicine, and fuel, with recently permitted aid convoys delivering insufficient quantities.
yazar: Mohammed Majed (Writing by Rania Abu Shamala)
